name: Red Cabbage
siboNotes: Well-tolerated cruciferous vegetable that's gentle on the digestive system. Cook thoroughly if experiencing any bloating.
preparationTips: Massage shredded raw cabbage with salt for easier digestion
Cook until tender to break down fiber for sensitive stomachs
Remove tough outer leaves and core before preparing
Add acidic ingredients like lemon juice to preserve bright color
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
Low in calories, high in fiber
